Overview

Ongata Rongai is a city in Kajiado with a population of 170,000. A rapidly growing suburban town south of Nairobi, popular with commuters working in the capital. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 255 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
